name: Marbet Fingerhat
original_name: マーベット・フィンガーハット
source:
From: Mobile Suit V Gundam
A pilot for the League Militaire. She was the test pilot for the Victory Gundam in Woowig but, due to herinijuries, was forced to yield the cockpit to Üso.
